properties.title: Thurgau Museum of Nature
properties.abstract: How about a detour to Frauenfeld to learn about the region's diverse natural environment? Decorated with the Swiss Prix Expo and nominated for the European Museum Award, the Thurgau Museum of Nature is one of Switzerland's outstanding natural history museums. Admission is free.
properties.description:
Kids in particular get their money's worth in the Thurgau Museum of Nature where they have the opportunity to explore many things themselves. In true-to-life displays they can discover many local plant and animal species. Fossils bring bygone times to life, whilst a lifelike beaver lodge and living ants are among the highlights of the exhibition. 

The audio tour ‘Mit Monty im Museum’ (With Monty in the Museum) takes museum visitors of all ages on an enjoyable tour of the exhibition.

After the tour, the museum café invites you to relax and unwind. In the foyer, the museum shop offers a selection of books, games and postcards. Admission is free.
